# Grace Church School

> > Grace Church School is an Episcopal K-12 institution dedicated to academic excellence, spiritual formation, and fostering dignity and belonging in its diverse community.

Grace Church School (GCS) is a comprehensive independent school offering programs from early childhood through grade 12, rooted in Episcopal traditions and values. The school emphasizes both rigorous academics and character development within a faith-based community.

- Episcopal identity
